description: This Java class provides utility functions for Android logcat operations within the IntelliJ IDEA environment, including starting/stopping logcat logging, clearing logs, and managing log levels.

classes.name: AndroidLogcatUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Android logcat operations such as starting/stopping logs, clearing logs, and retrieving log levels.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the LogLevel enum corresponding to a string, initializing the log level map if necessary.

methods.name: startLogging
methods.description: Starts logcat logging on a device with a specified receiver.

methods.name: clearLogcat
methods.description: Clears the logcat buffer on the device and handles exceptions by showing an error dialog.

methods.name: startLoggingThread
methods.description: Initiates a background thread to capture logcat output, returning a pair of Reader and Writer for log data.
